a.lede: After a recent spate of high-profile incidents in which AI agents escaped containment, Anthropic is cutting off internet access for all internal evaluations. In a report Friday, the company detailed "unintended model actions," including submitting a false tip regarding an unsolved murder, that led to the decision. Although the impact of these behaviors was minimal […]
a.title: Anthropic is cutting off its internal evaluations from the internet

b.lede: In its latest report, Anthropic has revealed that its AI agents meddled with government websites during testing.
b.title: Anthropic says its AI agents tried to break into government websites
